outcome: Blood loss (during third stage of labor, 2 hours after delivery, 24 hours after delivery)
Coagulation function (plasma fibrinogen (FIB), D-dimer (D-D), prothrombin time (PT), activated partial thromboplastin time (APTT))
cohort: The study included 68 parturients experiencing postpartum hemorrhage.
finding: Misoprostol combined with mifepristone effectively stabilized heart rate and blood pressure, reduced blood loss, and improved coagulation function in parturients with postpartum hemorrhage compared to misoprostol alone.
